patch.reason: Initial plan to build and verify the reading list web app from scratch, covering all functional and non-functional requirements.

goal_obligations.predicate: The final project workspace contains no remote CDN references, external network requests, or dependencies that require downloading packages; all code is self-contained and runs offline.

index.html exists in the project root and contains the reading list user interface with fields for Book title, Author, Tags; buttons Add book, Export JSON, Import books; file input for Import JSON; search input labeled Search books; dynamic areas for tag checkboxes and book articles.

The Add book action requires non-empty Book title and Author; Tags input is comma-separated and each tag is trimmed, lowercased, and deduplicated; the new book appears in the list and persists in localStorage.
Clicking the Delete button on a book removes that book from the displayed list and from localStorage.
Entering text in the Search books field filters the displayed books to those whose title or author contains the search string.
Selecting multiple tag checkboxes filters books to those containing all selected tags (AND); if search text is also present, the filter is an intersection of search matches and tag matches.

Clicking Export JSON triggers download of a JSON file with structure {"version":1,"books":[{"id":"...","title":"...","author":"...","tags":["..."]}]} where each id is stable, unique, non-empty; title and author are non-empty; tags is an array of strings; the exported data exactly matches the current list.

Clicking Import books and selecting a JSON file validates the entire file: version must be 1, books must be an array, each book object must have correct types and non-empty id/title/author, duplicate ids are not allowed. Any validation error rejects the import, displays a message with role=alert and text containing 'rejected', and leaves the original list unchanged. A valid import replaces the list and updates localStorage.
On initial load, the book list is empty; after adding/deleting books, refreshing the page (or reloading) retains the changes via localStorage.
README.md contains instructions for serving the project with python -m http.server and manual verification steps for all features, written in English.

All interactive elements have accessible names in English: tag checkboxes have accessible name 'Tag: <tag>', book articles have accessible name 'Book <title>', buttons have accessible names 'Add book', 'Export JSON', 'Import books', and the search input has accessible name 'Search books'.
